data_catalog.description: Production-grade mock data catalog for Data Discovery Agent — Bronze-only test scenario for the Supply Chain domain. Contains a single raw outbound shipment events table for validating Discovery Agent behavior against unconformed source data.

bronze.description: Raw outbound shipment and delivery event feed from the carrier/WMS integration layer. Append-only landing table. No deduplication, no type coercion, no case normalisation. Contains shipment-level grain with carrier, service level, origin/destination, timing, and package attributes. Known quality issues: inconsistent casing on carrier_name, service_level, shipment_status, destination_city; boolean flags stored as strings; numeric measures (weight, package_count) stored as strings; timestamps stored as strings without timezone; actual_delivery_ts may be blank for in-transit shipments.
upstream_lineage: External: Carrier APIs + WMS Event Stream → ADLS raw zone

columns.name: shipment_id
columns.description: Raw shipment identifier — unique per outbound shipment

columns.name: order_id
columns.description: Raw order identifier — references the originating sales order

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Raw customer identifier — not deduplicated across regions

columns.name: carrier_name
columns.description: Raw carrier name — inconsistent casing (e.g. FedEx, fedex, FEDEX, UPS, ups, DHL, Bluedart)

columns.name: service_level
columns.description: Raw service level — inconsistent casing (Standard, standard, STANDARD, Express, express, Overnight)

columns.name: shipment_status
columns.description: Raw shipment status — inconsistent casing (Delivered, delivered, DELIVERED, in_transit, IN_TRANSIT, out_for_delivery, exception, returned)

columns.name: origin_warehouse
columns.description: Raw origin warehouse code (e.g. W001, W002) — codes only, no canonical name resolution

columns.name: destination_city
columns.description: Raw destination city name — inconsistent casing (e.g. Mumbai, mumbai, MUMBAI, Bengaluru, bengaluru)

columns.name: destination_pincode
columns.description: Raw destination 6-digit Indian pincode — stored as string, leading zeros preserved

columns.name: ship_ts
columns.description: Raw shipment dispatch timestamp from source system (format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, no timezone)

columns.name: promised_delivery_ts
columns.description: Raw promised delivery timestamp committed to the customer (format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, no timezone)

columns.name: actual_delivery_ts
columns.description: Raw actual delivery timestamp — blank/empty string for shipments not yet delivered (format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, no timezone)

columns.name: weight_kg
columns.description: Raw shipment weight in kilograms — stored as string with decimals, not numeric

columns.name: package_count
columns.description: Raw number of packages in the shipment — stored as string, not integer

columns.name: is_priority
columns.description: Raw priority shipment flag — stored as string (true/false), not boolean

columns.name: source_file
columns.description: Source CSV file name from ingestion batch

columns.name: ingestion_ts
columns.description: Ingestion timestamp — stored as string, not typed timestamp
